description: Default batch byte limit from BoundednessPolicy::DEFAULT (1_048_576 bytes = 1 MiB). Production constant in crates/vb_core/src/budget.rs. This is a conservative upper bound for journal batch accumulation.
impact: All byte accounting and admission checks use this as the default limit
reason: Production policy constant verified by integration tests

description: RECORD_HEADER_LEN = 60 bytes from crates/vb_storage/src/codec/header.rs. Encoded record length always includes this 60-byte header overhead on top of payload bytes.
impact: Encoded byte accounting must use full encoded length, not payload-only
reason: Production constant verified by codec unit tests
compensating_evidence: Codec header tests verify the 60-byte header structure

description: MAX_JOURNAL_EVENT_PAYLOAD_BYTES = 262_144 (256 KiB). Per-record payload cap used in encode_record. This bound is never exceeded in the verification model.
impact: Limits the maximum encoded record length to 60 + 262144 = 262204 bytes
compensating_evidence: Constants are verified by unit tests

description: Guard precedence order in append_event per contract.md C6: key -> durable duplicate -> count (QueueFull) -> per-record payload (PayloadTooLarge) -> accumulated byte budget -> mutation (insert).
impact: Error variant returned depends on which guard fires first

description: u64::MAX is the arithmetic ceiling. All byte accounting uses checked_add; overflow returns typed rejection, never panic or wrap.
bound: all arithmetic is bounded by u64::MAX
impact: Overflow safety is guaranteed by Rust's checked_add returning None
reason: Rust type system (u64) + checked_add usage mandated by contract.md:C7
compensating_evidence: Kani harnesses exhaustively verify overflow behavior

description: JournalWriteBatch will gain staged_bytes: u64 and JournalBatchByteLimit field when byte accounting is implemented.
impact: Verification artifacts model these fields; implementation must add them
reason: Contract requires accumulated byte tracking (C3, C5, C9)
compensating_evidence: Verus specs model the fields and invariants

description: JournalError will gain AccumulatedBytesExceeded variant when byte accounting is implemented.
bound: new variant is distinct from QueueFull and PayloadTooLarge
impact: New error variant must be added to JournalError enum
reason: Contract C4 requires typed error distinct from QueueFull and PayloadTooLarge

description: fjall::OwnedWriteBatch insert/commit behavior is trusted. The batch accumulates writes across keyspaces and commits atomically.
bound: insertion order is preserved, commit is atomic
impact: Batch state management depends on fjall correctness
reason: External dependency; verified by fjall's own test suite
compensating_evidence: Integration tests verify fjall batch behavior

description: postcard serialization is trusted. encode_record uses postcard::to_allocvec for payload serialization.
bound: serialization is deterministic for same input
impact: Byte accounting depends on deterministic encoding length
reason: External dependency; verified by postcard's own test suite
compensating_evidence: Codec integration tests verify encode_record output length
